gbm_population_evidence.quote: Prior resection of histologically diagnosed high-grade gliomas (III and IV)

candidate_evidence.quote: Phase 0: 125 mg of infigratinib administered orally for 7 days prior to surgical resection.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Infigratinib in Recurrent High-Grade Glioma Patients

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Phase 0: Total infigratinib concentration in Gd enhancing and Gd non-enhancing tumor tissue collected intraoperatively, approximately 8 hours after study drug administration, will be determined by a validated liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry (LC-MS) method.

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: Phase 0: The mean percentage change of pERK positive cells in resected post-treatment recurrent high-grade glioma tumor tissue compared to baseline (archival primary high-grade glioma tumor tissue collected at screening) will be quantified using immunohistochemistry.

role_evidence.quote: Phase 0: 125 mg of infigratinib administered orally for 7 days prior to surgical resection.

source_quote.quote: Archival tissue must demonstrate: FGFR1 K656E or FGFR3 K650E mutation or FGFR3-TACC3 translocation from NGS sequencing or IHC and RT-PCR.

coder_notes: Early Phase 1 (Phase 0) tumour-penetration study with PK-triggered expansion; FGFR alteration required for entry (FGFR inhibitor). Population is recurrent high-grade glioma (III and IV) with GBM named in conditions. Exclusion criteria mention gemcitabine/cisplatin hypersensitivity only; not registered agents.
